title: Application Fee Rate on a Mortgage Loan File by Mortgage Pre-Approval Level
content:
The rate at which the program's application fee is charged on a Mortgage Loan File follows the level of the Mortgage Pre-Approval the file was converted from — the pre-approval the loan file names as the one its application was converted from, and that pre-approval's level.

**Rate table.**

| Level of the Mortgage Pre-Approval the file was converted from | Program application fee multiplied by |
|---|---|
| Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval | 0.5 |
| Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval | 0.5 |
| Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval | 0.5 |
| Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval | 0.75 |
| any other level, or no pre-approval the file was converted from | 1 — the fee is taken in full |

**Clause.** Where the pre-approval the file was converted from is a Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval, a Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval or a Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval, whose credit and income were already underwritten, the program fee is multiplied by 0.5 (50 percent); where it is a Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval it is multiplied by 0.75 (75 percent); where the file was converted from no pre-approval of those levels the program fee is taken in full.

## Examples (hypothetical, program application fee of 450.00 USD)

- File converted from a Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval: 450.00 multiplied by 0.5 is 225.00 USD.
- File converted from a Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval: 450.00 multiplied by 0.75 is 337.50 USD.
- File converted from a Larkspur Pre-Qualification, or opened without a pre-approval: the fee is taken in full, 450.00 USD.
- A customer who holds a Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval that the file was not converted from: the fee is taken in full; only the pre-approval the file was converted from counts.
